description: Look up genes, genomes, taxa and viruses in NCBI's databases from a workflow. Find genes by ID, symbol or accession, search an organism's genes, and list a gene's orthologs, transcripts and tissue expression; look up and search genome assemblies, list the genes and chromosomes of one and its versions; read a taxon's lineage, search taxon names and list the taxa within one; search and read virus genome sequences, BioSamples and organelle genomes. A trigger starts a workflow when NCBI releases a new genome assembly for a taxon. No account or API key required.
